title: The Glance: the first time I saw her 🌸
look: cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lenses, smooth stabilized gimbal and steadicam camera movement, gentle slow motion, shallow depth of field, soft golden morning light, dreamy pink and warm gold colour grade, film grain, photorealistic, vertical 9:16, no text. The place is a quiet tree-lined street in Bangalore in spring, both sides lined with pink trumpet trees (Tabebuia rosea, Bangalore's cherry blossoms) in full bloom, a canopy of pink flowers overhead, pink petals falling slowly and carpeting the road. The same two people in every shot. He is the young man: an original fictional character, a 25-year-old South Indian man, slim, youthful boyish face, short wavy black hair, clean-shaven with only very light stubble (no beard), warm brown eyes, a crisp white linen shirt with sleeves rolled up, beige chinos, a brown leather camera strap with a black mirrorless camera. She is the young woman: an original fictional character, a 24-year-old South Indian woman, long wavy black hair, a small black bindi, bright eyes, a soft mustard-yellow cotton kurta, white palazzo pants, a long pale white chiffon scarf (dupatta) draped around her neck and over her shoulders, her hair uncovered and open, a tan canvas tote bag on one shoulder

shots.prompt: Slow crane shot drifting down through a canopy of pink trumpet blossoms over the empty Bangalore street, petals falling in slow motion, morning sun through the flowers
He stands under the pink trees and lifts his camera to photograph the falling blossoms, smiling, petals drifting past
Over his shoulder, the camera pans slowly with him across the street and finds her: she is laughing softly, catching a falling pink petal in her open palm
Close-up of his face as he slowly lowers the camera from his eye, stunned, lips parting, the world going quiet, petals falling in front of him
Slow motion close-up: she tucks a strand of hair behind her ear, the white scarf moving in the breeze, then she senses someone looking and slowly turns her head
Wide two-shot across the petal-covered street: their eyes meet for the first time, both freeze, pink petals falling between them
Close-up: she looks down shyly with a small smile and plays with the end of her white scarf
A soft gust of wind lifts her white chiffon scarf from her shoulders and it floats away across the street through the falling petals in slow motion
He reaches up and catches the floating white scarf in mid-air, then looks at it in his hand and smiles
He walks across the street to her and gently holds out the white scarf; she reaches for it, their fingers almost touch, petals falling around them
Close two-shot: she takes her scarf back, they both laugh shyly, eyes meeting again, warm golden light
He turns his camera screen towards her to show the photo he took of her catching the petal; she covers her smile with her hand, delighted
They walk side by side slowly down the street under the pink blossom canopy, talking and smiling, the camera cranes up as petals fall
Wide shot from behind: the two of them walking away together down the long pink blossom street, petals swirling in the sunlight, the frame slowly fills with falling petals

description:
He came to photograph the blossoms. He ended up photographing her. 🌸

The first glance under Bangalore's pink trumpet trees.

Music: The Glance by ÆTHER (original score: humming, bansuri, violins, tabla). Original AI-made characters. Turn the volume up.
